 Haryana vs Tamil Nadu Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy live streaming 
 Haryana vs Tamil Nadu SMAT Live Streaming: Watch Yuzi Chahal in Action
 Sportsdunia Desk Published -  Nov 18, 2026, 06:47 AM 2 min comment Add on As Preferred Source Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy Yuzvendra Chahal Haryana are taking on Tamil Nadu in an Elite Group B encounter of the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy 2026-27 on Wednesday, November 18, at the Daly College Ground in Indore. Both teams have registered one win and suffered one loss in their opening two matches.
 Haryana lost their opening fixture against Punjab before going down to Saurashtra, while Tamil Nadu began their campaign with a win over Railways but suffered a narrow defeat against Jammu and Kashmir.
 With one of the best T20 bowlers of all time, Yuzvendra Chahal, featuring in this game, fans will be looking for the Haryana vs Tamil Nadu Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy live streaming details. Not just in Haryana techahalam, this match also features some of the top cricket stars in the Tamil Nadu side.
 Where to Watch Haryana vs Tamil Nadu SMAT 2026 Live?
 The Haryana vs Tamil Nadu SMAT 2026 live streaming is unavailable, as only a few selected matches from the group stage are being broadcast live on Star Sports Network and streamed on JioHotstar due to multiple fixtures taking place simultaneously.
 Fans looking for the Tamil Nadu vs Haryana SMAT live stream can still keep track of the action through Sportsdunia live cricket score , which provides ball-by-ball updates and match developments. Since the HAR vs TN SMAT game will be played in the afternoon, starting from 1:30 PM IST, the viewers will be eagerly looking forward to it.
 Advertisement
 How Has Yuzvendra Chahal Performed in First Two SMAT Matches?
 India leg-spinner Yuzvendra Chahal has had contrasting outings in Haryana's opening two matches of the tournament. He went wicketless in the first fixture against Punjab, conceding 27 runs in his four overs at an economy rate of 6.75. However, Haryana suffer a four-wicket defeat despite his economical spell.
 Chahal produced a much better performance against Saurashtra in the second match. The experienced leg-spinner claims three wickets for 27 runs in four overs, dismissing Harvik Desai, Harvansh Pangalia and Sammar Gajjar.
 His spell briefly puts Saurashtra under pressure during the chase, but Haryana eventually lose the match by six wickets. Over the years, he has been one of the best spinners in the world and will be looking to use all his experience here.
